User Story

As a system user

I want to view Collection channel’s listing 

So that I will be able to get information about Collection channel and perform needed operations

Design: https://xd.adobe.com/view/d4f196e5-7d0a-4dc9-a6c0-e4c374af9713-81a2/screen/56e7eeab-cea9-4ea1-bd2e-cc5a5b17a929/

Acceptance Criteria 

  1. Check system user permissions to view Collection channel's listing

    1. Viewing Collection channel

      1. Allows to see all non-deleted Collection channel in system 

    2. Viewing deleted Collection channel

      1. Allows to see deleted Collection channel

  2. Should load list of all Collection channel in system

    1. By default, it should display 25 records in one page with the possibility to change the number of displayed items in a page. Hardcoded values for dropdown: 25, 50, 100

  3. Exact match Checkbox

    1. Exact match checkbox — between “All” and search box; checked = exact match (not case sensitive); unchecked = partial match; BG: “Ð¿ÑÐ»Ð½Ð¾ ÑÑÐ²Ð¿Ð°Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ”(1)

  4. In each row in Collection channel list should load:

    1. ID

    2. Name

    3. Collection partner

    4. Type

    5. Currency

    6. Actions

      1. Edit

      2. Delete

  5. To display loader while loading the list

  6. Search/filter Collection channel list:

    1. To be able to search Collection channel by predefined parameters:

      1. ID

      2. Name

    2. Minimum 1 character is required to enable search icon

      1. Empty Search Box  state with gray search/clear search icon

    3. To be able to click on a search icon to run search when minimum 1 character is typed, or filter is selected

    4. To display loader while loading search results 

    5. To be able to select in which values to search for Collection channel:

      1. To be able to filter Collection channel by predefined parameters: 

        • Collection partner

          1. Multiselect dropdown

          2. Nomenclature

          3. Should be visible Active/Inactive Collection partner

        • Type

          • Multiselect dropdown

          • hardcoded values:

            • Offline

            • Online

        • Currency

          1. Multiselect dropdown

          2. Nomenclature

          3. Should be visible Active/Inactive Currency

    6. It is possible to clear filter and keep search result

    7. It is possible to clear search result and keep filters 

  7. Total count of records should be loaded

  8. Pagination

    • To be able to navigate through next/previous page

    • To be able to navigate to first/last page

    • To be able to use arrow back/forward for navigation

    • To be able to go to a certain page from dropdown  with available pages 

    • To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page 

  9. Up/down arrows next to column title for sorting full list 

    • ASC/DESC order

    • All columns should be sortable

  10. Create New Collection channel

    • Clicking on it will open Collection channel’s creation page

  11. View Collection channel

    • Clicking on a row will open Collection channel’s detail page, read only mode 

  12. Edit Collection channel

    1. Edit icon will be always visible and active

    2. Clicking on edit icon will open Collection channel’s detail page in editing mode

  13. Delete Collection channel

    1. For deleting Collection channel use should have permission “Deleting Collection channel”

      1. If no, disable delete icon

      2. If yes, enable delete icon

    2. By clicking on the delete icon system should display a warning message: “Are you sure you want to delete the Collection channel?”

      1. Yes- delete Collection channel

      2. Cancel – pop-up is closed and the Collection channel is not deleted

      3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

  14. Audit Log record should be created
